seo.title: Pawtrail · Midday dog walks in East Austin
seo.description: Small-group midday walks with the same friendly walker every week, plus photo updates. 10 walks for $150 for our first 40 dogs.

hero.headline: A happy dog by the time you're home
hero.sub: Midday walks in small groups with the same walker every week. You get photos and a map of the route while you're at work.

offer.title: The Founding Pack
bullets: Photo and route update after every walk
offer.note: We meet you and your dog first, for free, before the first walk.

how.title: Three steps to a calmer dog

steps.title: Book a meet & greet
steps.body: We come over, meet your dog and get the key routine sorted.

steps.title: We walk at midday
steps.body: 45 minutes in a group of three, on quiet routes near home.

steps.title: You get the update
steps.body: Photos and a map of the walk land on your phone.

services.title: What you can book
services.intro: Simple options that fit a long work day.

items.title: Group walk
items.body: Three dogs, one walker, 45 minutes of sniffing and play.

items.title: Solo walk
items.body: For puppies, seniors or dogs who prefer their own pace.

items.title: Drop-in visit
items.body: Fresh water, a cuddle and a quick potty break.

about.title: Why Pawtrail
about.body: We started Pawtrail because long office days are hard on dogs. Instead of a different stranger each time, your dog gets one walker who learns their quirks, their favorite tree and their friends.

local.title: Where we walk
local.body: We cover East Austin, on quiet streets and parks close to your home.

items.a: One named walker who you meet first. If they are ever sick, we tell you before the walk.
We agree on a key routine at the meet & greet and keep it the same every week.

items.q: What if my dog doesn't get along with others?
items.a: Then we book solo walks instead. We only group dogs that play well together.
With Bitcoin Cash from your phone: scan the code and you're done, no card needed.
Yes, tell us a day before and the walk stays in your pack.

finalCta.headline: Give your dog a better Tuesday
finalCta.sub: Founding Packs are limited to our first 40 dogs.
